entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Item   Uses
entities.Description: A   record   that   a   member   opened ,  uploaded ,  or   promoted   an   item .

Fields.Name: ItemID
Fields.Description: The   space   item   that   was   used .

Fields.Name: UserID
Fields.Description: The   member   who   opened ,  uploaded ,  or   promoted   the   item .

Fields.Name: UsedAt
Fields.Description: When   the   use   happened .

Fields.Name: Kind
Fields.Description: open ,  upload ,  or   promote .

Fields.Name: SpaceID
Fields.Description: The   space   the   use   happened   in .  Required   so   the   read   filter   can   keep   the   row   inside   spaces   the   caller   reaches .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Share   Notices
entities.Description: A   notice   that   an   item   in   this   space   was   shared   with   a   member .

Fields.Name: SpaceID
Fields.Description: The   space   the   notice   belongs   to .  The   read   filter   keeps   a   caller   inside   spaces   they   reach .

Fields.Name: ItemID
Fields.Description: The   space   item   that   was   shared .

Fields.Name: RecipientUserID
Fields.Description: The   member   the   notice   is   for .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Anchors
entities.Description: A   record   a   space   is   about  ( D26 :  a   space   may   have   several ).  The   primary   anchor   is   the   one   EnsureSpaceForRecord   finds   a   space   by ;  one   per   space ,  and   one   space   per  ( type ,  record )  as   primary .

Fields.Name: SpaceID
Fields.Description: The   space .

Fields.Name: SpaceTypeID
Fields.Description: The   space ' s   type ,  denormalized   so   the   primary - per - type   index   can   hold ;  the   server   keeps   it   equal   to   the   space ' s   and   rewrites   it   when   the   type   changes .

Fields.Name: EntityID
Fields.Description: The   entity   of   the   anchored   record .

Fields.Name: RecordID
Fields.Description: The   record ' s   key ,  in   the   canonical   shape   SpaceItem . RecordID   uses .

Fields.Name: Role
Fields.Description: What   the   record   is   to   the   space ,  in   the   type ' s   vocabulary :  chapter ,  sponsor ,  event .  Data   reach  ( D28 )  names   an   anchor   by   this   role .

Fields.Name: IsPrimary
Fields.Description: The   one   anchor   a   space   is   found   by .  At   most   one   per   space .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Display   order   among   the   space ' s   anchors .

Fields.Name: ArchivedOnSpaceClose
Fields.Description: Indicates   whether   this   space   chat   conversation   was   archived   when   its   space   was   closed   so   it   can   be   restored   on   reopen .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Grants
entities.Description: Something   the   app ,  a   space   type   or   a   space   offers   in   its   spaces  ( D27 ' s   seven   kinds ):  an   agent ,  an   action ,  a   query ,  a   view ,  a   dashboard ,  a   component   or   a   knowledge   source ,  with   the   band   that   may   use   it ,  bindings   from   the   space   to   the   target ' s   parameters ,  and   an   agent ' s   narrowed   settings .  Replaces   SpaceAgent ,  SpaceAgentSkill   and   SpaceKnowledgeSource .

Fields.Name: SpaceTypeID
Fields.Description: The   type   the   grant   belongs   to ;  null   with   SpaceID   null   is   the   app ' s   own   row .

Fields.Name: SpaceID
Fields.Description: The   space   the   grant   belongs   to ;  never   set   together   with   SpaceTypeID .

Fields.Name: Kind
Fields.Description: Agent ,  Action ,  Query ,  View ,  Dashboard ,  Component   or   KnowledgeSource .  TargetEntityID   must   be   the   kind ' s   entity .

Fields.Name: TargetEntityID
Fields.Description: The   target ' s   entity :  MJ :  AI   Agents ,  MJ :  Actions ,  MJ :  Queries ,  MJ :  User   Views ,  MJ :  Dashboards ,  MJ :  Components   or   MJ :  Content   Sources ,  by   Kind .

Fields.Name: TargetRecordID
Fields.Description: The   target   record ' s   key .

Fields.Name: Label
Fields.Description: What   the   space   calls   the   target ;  null   uses   the   target ' s   own   name .

Fields.Name: Band
Fields.Description: The   band   that   may   use   the   grant  ( D31 ).  A   Team   grant   is   not   offered   in   a   chat   where   anyone   cannot   see   Team .

Fields.Name: IsDefault
Fields.Description: For   an   Agent   grant :  the   agent   a   chat   at   this   level   starts   with .  One   per   level .

Fields.Name: Bindings
Fields.Description: JSON  ( SpaceGrantBindings ):  the   target ' s   parameter   or   property   names   mapped   to   where   each   value   comes   from :  an   anchor   by   role ,  a   column   of   the   space ,  a   configuration   key ,  the   user ,  or   a   literal  ( D27 ).

Fields.Name: Settings
Fields.Description: JSON  ( AgentGrantSettings )  for   an   Agent   grant :  skills ,  plan   mode ,  effort ,  memory   writes   and   per - run   limits ,  each   only   narrowing   the   agent ' s   own   definition  ( D31 ).  Null   for   the   other   kinds .

Fields.Name: Mode
Fields.Description: Extend   adds   the   target   at   this   level ;  Remove   takes   a   target   granted   above   out   of   this   level ' s   list  ( D30 ).

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Display   order   within   the   level .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Items
entities.Description: An   item   in   exactly   one   space :  EntityID  +  RecordID ,  plus   Team   or   Shared .  Unique   on  ( EntityID ,  RecordID )  so   an   item   cannot   have   two   parents .

Fields.Name: EntityID
Fields.Description: The   entity   the   item   points   at .  Same   polymorphic   pair   TaskLink   uses .

Fields.Name: RecordID
Fields.Description: Primary   key   of   the   pointed - at   record ,  as   text ,  matching   TaskLink . RecordID .

Fields.Name: Band
Fields.Description: Team  ( working   material ,  not   in   the   client - facing   agent   scope )  or   Shared  ( promoted ,  with   an   actor   and   a   timestamp ).

Fields.Name: PromotedAt
Fields.Description: When   a   Shared   item   was   promoted .  Null   on   Team   items .

Fields.Name: PromotedByUserID
Fields.Description: MJ   user   who   promoted   a   Shared   item .  Required   together   with   PromotedAt .  Null   on   Team   items .

Fields.Name: Folder
Fields.Description: Folder   label   inside   the   space .  Null   means   Unfiled .  Collections   cannot   say   everyone   in   the   space ,  so   the   folder   lives   on   the   item .

Fields.Name: ArtifactVersionID
Fields.Description: For   a   document   in   the   Library :  the   MJ   Artifact   Version  ( ContentMode   File )  wrapping   the   MJ :  Files   row   the   item   points   at ,  so   the   document   has   a   type ,  a   viewer   and   versions .  NULL   for   items   that   are   not   files .  Artifact   Permissions   are   not   used   by   the   Library ;  the   roster   is   the   one   sharing   model .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Member   Pins
entities.Description: Something   a   member   keeps   at   the   top   of   a   space  ( B22 ):  a   record   of   the   space  ( an   item ,  a   note ,  a   task )  or   one   of   the   space ' s   grants  ( a   view ,  a   dashboard ,  a   component ).  The   member ' s   own ;  Home   lists   pins   from   the   spaces   they   still   reach .

Fields.Name: SpaceID
Fields.Description: The   space   the   pin   is   in .

Fields.Name: UserID
Fields.Description: Whose   pin   it   is :  the   caller .

Fields.Name: Kind
Fields.Description: Record :  a   record   of   the   space   by   entity   and   key .  Grant :  one   of   the   space ' s   grants .

Fields.Name: TargetEntityID
Fields.Description: For   a   Record   pin :  the   record ' s   entity .

Fields.Name: TargetRecordID
Fields.Description: For   a   Record   pin :  the   record ' s   key .

Fields.Name: GrantID
Fields.Description: For   a   Grant   pin :  the   grant   in   force   for   the   member ' s   space   and   band .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: The   member ' s   order   of   pins .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Members
entities.Description: One   roster   row   per   user   per   space .  Staff   and   outsiders   are   both   MJ   users .  Status   Active   is   the   row   the   membership   filter   accepts .

Fields.Name: Band
Fields.Description: Team   or   Shared .  Set   by   the   server   from   the   role :  CanSeeTeamBand   seats   the   person   on   Team ,  otherwise   Shared .  The   filter   reads   the   role ,  not   this   column .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Invited ,  Active ,  or   Removed .  New   rows   start   Invited   unless   the   type   auto - approves .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Notes
entities.Description: A   light   note   in   a   space  ( B21 ):  the   space ' s   own   row   on   a   band ,  not   a   library   item ,  so   the   move - and - promote   rules   do   not   apply   and   it   needs   no   ItemUse .  Private   notes   are   the   author ' s   alone .

Fields.Name: SpaceID
Fields.Description: The   space   the   note   belongs   to .

Fields.Name: Title
Fields.Description: The   note ' s   title .

Fields.Name: Body
Fields.Description: The   note ' s   body ,  Markdown .

Fields.Name: Band
Fields.Description: Team   or   Shared :  who   in   the   space   may   read   it .  A   Team   note   moves   to   Shared   only   when   the   plan ' s   call   15   allows   it .

Fields.Name: Visibility
Fields.Description: Space :  the   band   reads   it .  Private :  the   author   alone ,  and   then   the   band   is   Team .

Fields.Name: AuthorUserID
Fields.Description: Who   wrote   the   note :  the   caller   on   create ,  and   the   only   one   who   edits   or   deletes   it .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Role   Types
entities.Description: What   a   space   member   is   allowed   to   do .  The   engine   reads   Level   and   the   BIT   flags .  It   never   compares   Code   or   Name .

Fields.Name: Level
Fields.Description: This   role ' s   own   authority .  A   grant   must   be   of   a   role   whose   Level   is  <=  the   grantor ' s   MaxGrantableLevel .

Fields.Name: MaxGrantableLevel
Fields.Description: Highest   Level   this   role   may   grant .  Always  <=  Level .

Fields.Name: CanInvite
Fields.Description: Holder   may   invite   members   into   a   space   they   belong   to ,  inside   their   own   subtree ,  at   or   below   MaxGrantableLevel .

Fields.Name: CanPromoteBand
Fields.Description: Holder   may   move   an   item   from   Team   to   Shared .

Fields.Name: CanSeeTeamBand
Fields.Description: Holder   may   read   Team - band   items .  Shared - band   items   do   not   need   this   flag .

Fields.Name: IsOwnerRole
Fields.Description: The   role   that   defines   ownership   of   a   space .  The   engine   reads   the   flag ,  not   the   name .

Fields.Name: CanContribute
Fields.Description: 1   if   the   role   may   contribute   content  ( create ,  update ,  or   post   items ,  tasks ,  and   messages );  0   for   read - only   roles .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Type   Status
entities.Description: A   status   a   space   type   offers   its   spaces :  Active ,  Paused ,  Closed   and   Archived   ship   for   every   type ;  a   type   may   add   its   own .  A   space   is   in   exactly   one   of   its   type ' s   statuses  ( Space . StatusID )  and   may   only   choose   among   them .  The   attributes   say   what   a   space   in   the   status   allows ;  the   type ' s   driver   may   still   refuse   a   change .

Fields.Name: SpaceTypeID
Fields.Description: The   type   this   status   belongs   to .

Fields.Name: Code
Fields.Description: The   status ' s   key   within   its   type :  active ,  paused ,  closed ,  archived ,  or   a   type ' s   own .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: What   the   status   is   called   on   screen .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: The   definitive   order   of   the   type ' s   statuses ,  for   display   and   for   the   rule   that   a   terminal   status   may   only   move   forward .

Fields.Name: IsDefault
Fields.Description: The   status   a   new   space   of   the   type   starts   in ;  one   per   type .

Fields.Name: ReadOnly
Fields.Description: Members   may   read   but   not   post ,  upload ,  assign   or   edit   while   the   space   is   in   this   status .

Fields.Name: Visible
Fields.Description: The   space   is   listed   and   reachable   by   its   members ;  off   hides   it   from   everyone   but   its   owner   and   staff .

Fields.Name: AgentRetrieval
Fields.Description: An   agent   may   quote   the   space ' s   material   while   it   is   in   this   status .

Fields.Name: CanChangeAfter
Fields.Description: Once   a   space   reaches   this   status   it   may   still   move   to   another ;  off   freezes   it   there .  A   frozen   status   must   be   terminal .

Fields.Name: NotifyMembersOnEnter
Fields.Description: Entering   this   status   sends   the   space ' s  " status   changed "  notice ,  one   per   member ,  through   MJ ' s   notification   chain .

Fields.Name: IsTerminal
Fields.Description: Entering   this   status   stamps   Space . ClosedAt ;  retention   and   the   closed   views   count   from   it .  From   a   terminal   status   a   space   may   move   only   to   a   higher   Sequence ,  never   back   to   an   open   one .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Types
entities.Description: Kind   of   space :  vocabulary ,  which   panels   are   on ,  retention   and   agent   defaults ,  and   how   outsiders   join .  Behavior   lives   in   these   columns ,  not   in   code   branched   on   the   name .

Fields.Name: Code
Fields.Description: Stable   metadata   key .  The   engine   does   not   branch   on   it .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display   name   of   the   type .

Fields.Name: Vocabulary
Fields.Description: Human   noun   for   spaces   of   this   type  ( workspace ,  committee ,  cohort ,  community ).  Open   set .

Fields.Name: Discoverability
Fields.Description: Hidden ,  Listed ,  or   Open .  Modelled   now ;  the   community   surface   that   uses   Listed   and   Open   is   a   later   release .

Fields.Name: JoinMode
Fields.Description: InviteOnly ,  RequestToJoin ,  or   SelfServe .

Fields.Name: MessagingPanel
Fields.Description: Conversation   panel   is   on   for   spaces   of   this   type .

Fields.Name: LibraryPanel
Fields.Description: File   library   panel   is   on .

Fields.Name: WorkPanel
Fields.Description: Task  /  work   panel   is   on .

Fields.Name: DefaultAgentRetrieval
Fields.Description: Default   AgentRetrieval   for   a   new   space   of   this   type .

Fields.Name: DefaultBand
Fields.Description: Default   Team   or   Shared   band   for   a   new   item   in   a   space   of   this   type .

Fields.Name: InviteApproval
Fields.Description: Approve :  a   new   member   stays   Invited   until   an   owner   of   the   space   sets   them   Active .  AutoApprove :  the   server   creates   the   member   Active .  The   invited   person   does   not   activate   themselves .

Fields.Name: MemberCap
Fields.Description: Maximum   members   in   one   space   of   this   type .  Null   means   no   cap .

Fields.Name: DefaultAllowParentAssignees
Fields.Description: Default   AllowParentAssignees   setting   for   new   spaces   of   this   type .

Fields.Name: IconClass
Fields.Description: Font   Awesome   icon   class   representing   the   space   type  ( e . g .,  fa - solid   fa - compass ).

Fields.Name: Color
Fields.Description: Hex   color   code   representing   the   space   type  ( e . g ., # 0076b6 ).

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Spaces
entities.Description: The   container .  Permission   boundary   and   agent   retrieval   boundary ,  as   a   tree :  one   root   per   relationship ,  sub - spaces   for   the   work   inside   it .

Fields.Name: ParentID
Fields.Description: Parent   space .  Null   on   a   root .  It   does   not   carry   the   IsHierarchy   flag ,  so   CodeGen   emits   no   path   columns .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Designated   name   of   the   space .

Fields.Name: OwnerID
Fields.Description: MJ   user   who   owns   the   space .

Fields.Name: InheritsMembership
Fields.Description: 1 :  members   of   this   space   are   members   of   its   descendants .  0 :  this   sub - space   keeps   its   own   roster .

Fields.Name: AgentRetrieval
Fields.Description: Included ,  ExcludedFromParentScope ,  or   ExcludedEntirely .  A   human   may   read   a   space   that   no   agent   may   quote .

Fields.Name: StartedAt
Fields.Description: When   this   space  ( usually   a   sub - space )  started .  The   root   outlives   its   children .

Fields.Name: ClosedAt
Fields.Description: When   this   space   closed .  Closure   is   a   timestamp   on   the   sub - space ,  not   a   delete   of   the   root .

Fields.Name: AllowParentAssignees
Fields.Description: 1   if   participants   in   this   space   may   assign   people   seated   on   ancestor   spaces   whose   membership   reaches   this   space ;  0   to   restrict   assignment   to   seats   in   this   space   or   below .  Only   staff   may   change   this   switch .

Fields.Name: PlannedCloseAt
Fields.Description: Target   or   planned   close   date / time   for   the   space .  Actual   closure   is   recorded   in   ClosedAt .

Fields.Name: IconClass
Fields.Description: Font   Awesome   icon   class   representing   the   space  ( e . g .,  fa - solid   fa - folder - tree ,  fa - solid   fa - briefcase ).  Overrides   SpaceType . IconClass   if   set .

Fields.Name: Color
Fields.Description: Hex   color   code   representing   the   space  ( e . g ., # 0076b6 , # 10b981 ).  Overrides   SpaceType . Color   if   set .

Fields.Name: BackgroundImageURL
Fields.Description: URL   of   an   optional   hero   banner   or   background   image   displayed   in   the   space   header   and   overview .

Fields.Name: StatusID
Fields.Description: The   status   the   space   is   in ,  one   of   its   type ' s  ( SpaceTypeStatus ).  NULL   until   the   server   stamps   it :  then   the   type ' s   default   while   ClosedAt   is   null ,  and   the   type ' s   first   terminal   status   once   ClosedAt   is   set ,  as   fnCollaborationSpaceStatuses   derives   it .
